title: 三点
three: 世界锁：只有一个世界，深夜下雨的小便利店，安静、冷暖对冲；屋里暖黄台灯和冷白灯管，门外是雨夜的街。
music: 配乐：没有配乐，只有冰柜的嗡嗡声、门外的雨声和推门的风铃声。

characters.name: 阿青
characters.mark_zh: 深蓝工装、左手旧电子表
characters.lock: 阿青：二十出头的成年女人，瘦，齐肩黑发别在耳后；穿洗旧的深蓝色工装外套和黑色长裤，白色帆布鞋；左手腕戴一块旧电子表。
characters.brief_en: a tired young night-shift convenience-store clerk, clearly an adult in her early twenties.
characters.must_en: worn dark-blue work jacket, black trousers, white canvas shoes, an old digital watch on the left wrist, shoulder-length black hair tucked behind the ears.
characters.voice_en: a young woman with a light, slightly husky voice who speaks slowly

characters.name: 老周
characters.lock: 老周：上了年纪的男人，眼角皱纹很深，微胖，短寸头花白；穿一件旧灰色夹克，肩膀被雨淋湿，深色裤子，黑皮鞋。
characters.brief_en: a heavy-set older man with deep crow's feet, a regular late-night customer.
characters.must_en: old grey jacket with rain-wet shoulders, dark trousers, black leather shoes, short greying buzz cut.
characters.voice_en: an older man with a low, hoarse voice who speaks briefly

props.name: 香烟
props.lock: 香烟：一包没有任何字和标志的素白色烟盒，有点皱。
props.en: one plain white cigarette pack with no text or logo, slightly crumpled.
props.must_en: Exactly one pack. Plain white, no printing at all.

locations.name: 便利店
locations.lock: 便利店：深夜的小便利店；收银台在玻璃门的左手边，台上一盏暖黄色小台灯；三排货架在冷白灯管下；玻璃门外是下雨的街和窄屋檐。
locations.en: a small convenience store late at night.
locations.must_en: The cashier counter stands to the left of the glass door with one small warm desk lamp; three aisles under cold white tubes; rain on the street outside the glass door under a narrow awning.
check: 暖黄台灯 + 冷白灯管
